svg.title: Witchcore Potion Cabinet — clickable paint-by-number
svg.desc: A packed apothecary cabinet of glowing bottles, herbs, and tea-colored elixirs. Click a numbered region to toggle its suggested color. Shift-click paints every region with the same number.
